The '''Quinn family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family that lived in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Many of its members, such as [[Rymar Quinn]] and his son [[Malavai Quinn]], served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]].
